items.title: CVE-2026-77382 - falcon-rust is a Rust implementation of the Falcon post-quantum signature scheme...
items.body: falcon-rust is a Rust implementation of the Falcon post-quantum signature scheme. Prior to 0.2.0, the discrete-Gaussian sampler in src/samplerz.rs evaluates approx_exp, ber_exp, and sampler_z acceptance probabilities with FixedPoint64 values having only 32 fractional bits. The scaling in approx_exp quantizes its input and limits relative precision to about 2^-33, below Falcon's required bound, causing reference known-answer vectors to diverge and invalidating the proof assumption that secret-dependent signature and key distributions are negligibly close to the ideal discrete Gaussian. This is a cryptographic-soundness defect and no practical key-recovery attack has been demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 0.2.0.

items.body: Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. From 0.11.4 until 0.12.30, the generic GET /yjs/:documentName WebSocket route in InitializeYjsResources requires a session but does not authorize the database resource selected by a typename.referenceId.columnName room name. The YJS initial-content provider then reads the selected file.* column without CanRead or CanUpdate checks, and bidirectional synchronization allows a low-privileged authenticated user to read or modify restricted row content. items.body: Daptin is a GraphQL/JSON-API headless CMS. Prior to 0.12.30, the generic GET /api/{entity} list endpoint accepts attacker-controlled sort values in PaginatedFindAllWithoutFilters in server/resource/resource_findallpaginated.go without validating the requested column against the table schema. The code uses those values for SELECT and ORDER BY identifier construction, so an embedded identifier quote can terminate the quoted identifier and make the remainder parse as SQL, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to extract unauthorized table data through blind or error-based behavior or repeatedly trigger query failures. items.title: CVE-2026-77359 - Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. Prior to 1.0....
items.body: Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. Prior to 1.0.3, standalone streamable-http mode validates Host and Origin values for /mcp but does not apply the same browser-origin controls to the state-changing /api/connect and /api/stop management routes. A malicious website can use DNS rebinding so that its hostname resolves to a loopback, LAN, VPN, or published-container MCP listener, then send a browser-shaped request that /api/connect accepts to replace runtime_url and document_url values and start a kernel client against attacker-controlled infrastructure. The attacker can thereby cause Jupyter API and WebSocket traffic to reach that infrastructure and can use /api/stop to stop the current notebook kernel. The default broad bind can increase exposure, but the vulnerability is the missing management-route origin boundary, not a lack of Host validation on /mcp. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.3.

On a network-reachable affected deployment, an unauthenticated attacker can sign JWTs with arbitrary claims, including system-administrator claims, to access administrative functionality and read or modify family, child activity, account, and email data. Deployments with a strong unique JWT_SECRET are not affected. Managed and hosted instances were reported remediated. This issue is fixed in version 1.3.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-77336 - Aperi'Solve is an open-source steganalysis web platform. Prior to 3.4.2, an unau...
items.body: Aperi'Solve is an open-source steganalysis web platform. Prior to 3.4.2, an unauthenticated user can submit a PNG to POST /upload, which reaches aperisolve/utils/png.py through analyze_image, PCRTAnalyzer, PNG.repair(), and check_idat(). A malformed IDAT chunk can make attacker-controlled length and newline data drive an unbounded combinations search in PNG._fix_dos2unix(), causing repeated CRC checks that occupy a worker and delay or block image analysis for other users. Per-IP upload limits and eventual job termination bound the denial of service, and the issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 3.4.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-77318 - Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. Prior to 1.0....
items.body: Jupyter MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol server for Jupyter. Prior to 1.0.3, standalone streamable-http mode can enforce MCP_TOKEN on /mcp while leaving the state-changing /api/connect and /api/stop management routes unauthenticated. An unauthenticated network caller can use /api/connect to replace runtime_url and document_url values and their tokens, reset ServerContext, and start a kernel client against attacker-controlled infrastructure, causing the server to send Jupyter API and WebSocket traffic to that backend. The caller can also use /api/stop to stop the current notebook kernel. This boundary failure does not require explicit insecure no-auth mode and occurs outside normal MCP JSON-RPC tool dispatch. From 0.5.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS does not format the SSH URL path component as a single argument when constructing remote object-transfer or authentication commands. Shell metacharacters in the SSH URL can therefore escape the intended path argument and cause arbitrary command execution when the remote Git LFS service passes received commands to a shell without adequate sanitization. Git LFS also incorrectly encodes default HTTPS URLs when an SSH URL is configured and the remote host either does not support Git LFS remote commands over SSH or supports HTTP authentication over SSH but git-lfs-authenticate does not return an explicit HTTP URL. items.title: CVE-2026-133276 - When extra data is allowed (extra=Extra.allow), providing a __pydantic_initialis...
items.body: When extra data is allowed (extra=Extra.allow), providing a __pydantic_initialised__ key when validating a Pydantic V1 dataclass makes it considered as already validated, resulting in field values not being validated. The __init__() method of Pydantic V1 dataclasses stores all the provided keyword arguments in the instance __dict__ before validation, so a __pydantic_initialised__ keyword argument overrides the internal flag used to skip validation of already validated instances. As a result, data returned by validation doesn't match the declared type. Affected are applications validating untrusted data into Pydantic V1 dataclasses allowing extra data. The issue was fixed in Pydantic 1.10.27. Users relying on the pydantic.v1 namespace in Pydantic V2 should upgrade to 2.14.2 or later.

items.body: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, Prover9Parent.config_prover9 and Mace accept a relative binary_location and pass it to find_binary as path_to_bin, disabling the bare-name absolute-path guard. items.body: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, XMLCorpusView.read_block rebuilds the full root-to-node context path with "/".join(context) for every start tag while searching for a matching element. Deeply nested attacker-influenced corpus XML therefore causes quadratic pure-Python work and can pin a processing worker, resulting in denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-105803 - Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 1.3.0 until 3.8.1, G...
items.body: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 1.3.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS does not correctly filter the limited set of options permitted in a repository's .lfsconfig file when option keys contain certain additional components. Crafted keys can mimic options that configure Git LFS to use a custom command to transfer objects, causing Git LFS to execute an attacker-selected command or binary while fetching objects. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

In Eclipse iceoryx-rs, versions 0.0.11 to 0.0.13 and 0.1.0 as well as on the latest main branch.



`SampleReceiver::<T>::take()` and `Sample::<T>::deref()` are safe functions that hand the caller a `&T` pointing at a chunk written by another iceoryx process, but the subscriber path neither requires `T: ShmSend` nor verifies that the received chunk is at least `size_of::<T>()` bytes / `align_of::<T>()`-aligned. A peer process that publishes an undersized chunk, or any chunk at all when the subscriber chose a pointer-bearing `T`, drives a `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` subscriber into out-of-bounds reads of adjacent shared-memory chunks or dereference of a publisher-controlled pointer.



Resolution:



It will not be fixed since this is a known limitation in iceoryx as it is the users responsibility to specify the same data type on sender and receiver side.



[iceoryx2](https://github.com/eclipse-iceoryx/iceoryx2) is the successor of iceoryx-rs where the API is designed to prevent this by default.



It is strongly recommended to migrate to iceoryx2 which is actively maintained and receives security support.



The iceoryx-rs package has officially reached End-of-life and will not receive any features, bugfixes or security fixes.

items.title: CVE-2026-110728 - The AIKTP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass via Predict...
items.body: The AIKTP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass via Predictable Token in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.7. The vulnerability exists because the plugin's sync token (`aiktpz_token`) is generated using PHP's non-cryptographic `uniqid()` function — producing a wall-clock-derived value with approximately one million microsecond candidates per uncertain generation second — while the unauthenticated, unthrottled REST endpoint `/wp-json/aiktp/checkToken` (registered with `permission_callback => __return_true`) acts as a public brute-force oracle for the token; simultaneously, the capability checks in `check_valid_token` and its wrappers (`verify_aiktp_token_with_edit_capability`, `verify_aiktp_token_with_upload_capability`) inspect only a server-side stored Administrator account (option `aiktp_author`) rather than the actual REST caller, meaning possession of the token alone grants Administrator-equivalent authority to any external request. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to recover the sync token and then invoke `POST /wp-json/aiktp/createpost` to publish arbitrary posts attributed to a site Administrator, `POST /wp-json/aiktp/doUpdatePostWithImageURL` to overwrite the body content of any existing post, and `POST /wp-json/aiktp/doUploadImageToWP` to import remote media and attach it as the featured image of any post. Additionally, when the `aiktpz_token` option has never been initialized, the `checkToken` oracle returns success for an empty token submission due to a loose comparison in `check_valid_token`, providing a zero-effort bypass that requires no brute-forcing whatsoever.

items.body:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv6: raw: fix use-after-free in rawv6_send_hdrinc()

rawv6_send_hdrinc() caches the route before handing the skb to
l3mdev_ip6_out(). The VRF output path may replace skb->dst and release
the original route, leaving the cached pointer stale.

The function later dereferences that pointer for statistics accounting
and as the output device passed to NF_HOOK(). Its RCU read-side critical
section starts after l3mdev_ip6_out(), so it cannot prevent the old route
from being reclaimed in between.

Reload the route from the current skb destination after
l3mdev_ip6_out() returns.

KASAN reports a slab-use-after-free in rawv6_sendmsg(), with the route
allocated by ip6_dst_alloc(), freed by dst_destroy() from rcu_core(), and
the related RCU callback queued from vrf_l3_out().

items.title: CVE-2026-132043 - In Eclipse Yasson versions 3.0 to 3.0.5, a race condition (CWE-362) exists in th...
items.body: In Eclipse Yasson versions 3.0 to 3.0.5, a race condition (CWE-362) exists in the handling of @JsonbNumberFormat. Yasson creates one java.text.NumberFormat instance per annotated property and shares it across all threads that use the same Jsonb instance. NumberFormat is not thread-safe, and the deserializer called parse() on it without synchronization. When multiple threads deserialize concurrently, a thread can receive a numeric value that belongs to another thread's input, receive an incorrect value, or fail with an exception. A remote attacker who can send concurrent requests to an application that deserializes untrusted JSON this way may cause incorrect data to be processed or cause another user's value to be returned. Exploitation requires that the application use @JsonbNumberFormat with a shared Jsonb instance and that the attacker win a timing race. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.6 by synchronizing access to the shared NumberFormat instances.

items.title: CVE-2026-117678 - Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in benoitc idna allows an attac...
items.body:
Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in benoitc idna allows an attacker who controls a hostname passed to the library to exhaust CPU via an over-long xn-- label. idna:ulabel/1 in src/idna.erl hands every ASCII label that starts with xn-- to punycode:decode/1 without applying check_label_length/1, the 63-octet DNS label limit. punycode:decode/1 in src/punycode.erl builds its output with list appends in insert/4, so its cost grows super-linearly with the label length. A label of a few kilobytes keeps a scheduler busy for seconds to minutes before the label is rejected as invalid punycode.

Every decode entry point reaches this path: decode/1, decode/2, to_unicode/1 and from_ascii/1. The encode path reaches it as well, because alabel/1 calls ulabel/1 on an ASCII xn-- label before its own length check, so encode/1, encode/2 and to_ascii/1 are affected for such input.

This issue affects idna: from 0.5.0 before 8.0.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-109555 - The WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro plugins for WordPress are vulnerable to PHP Ob...
items.body: The WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro plugins for WordPress are vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 and 6.17.0, respectively, via deserialization of untrusted input during database restore and staging reset. This is due to the database importer treating attacker-controlled text beginning with {WPSTG_BINARY} as trusted internal binary data and decoding its hexadecimal suffix into serialized bytes. When an Administrator later performs an ordinary database-including restore or staging reset containing that value, and the restored profile metadata is loaded, either during the restore or in a later request, a built-in POP chain can be used to execute arbitrary code on the server. Additional built-in gadget chains allow arbitrary local file read in both WP STAGING and WP STAGING Pro and arbitrary file deletion in WP STAGING Pro. The attacker does not require Administrator credentials or a copy of a backup, but exploitation does require the later privileged restore or reset.

items.body: AIOHTTPは、asyncioおよびPython向けの非同期HTTPクライアント/サーバーフレームワークです。バージョン3.14.4以前では、WebSocketリーダーが不完全なフレームを再構築する際に、各トランスポート読み取りごとに1つのバイトオブジェクトを保持していました。悪意のあるピアはフレームを非常に小さな読み取りに分割できるため、個々のオブジェクトのオーバーヘッドがmax_msg_sizeで許可されたペイロードバイト数を大幅に超過してしまいます。この状況は、悪意のあるクライアントからフレームを受信するサーバーおよび悪意のあるサーバーからフレームを受信するクライアントの両方に影響を及ぼし、過剰なメモリ消費やサービス拒否（DoS）を引き起こす可能性があります。この問題はバージョン3.14.4で修正されています。

items.title: CVE-2026-130787 - Frappe ERPNext before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ...

Attackers can send crafted requests to affected reporting endpoints to read other companies' tax and payment data, including personal and corporate identifiers and financial totals.

items.title: CVE-2026-130786 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows users who can launch instances from controlled images to inject LXC directives by embedding line breaks in OCI config.json values or oci.entrypoint and oci.cwd keys. Attackers can add liblxc hooks or crafted tmpfs lxc.mount.entry fields to run commands as root on the host or bind-mount host paths, even from restricted projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130785 - Incus from 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in...
items.body: Incus from 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest API that allows a process in one container to impersonate another by creating a cgroup named with a forged lxc.monitor. component. Attackers can read the target container's user.* and cloud-init.* configuration and devices, subscribe to its events, mark it ready, and export images across projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130784 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows re...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted clients to create and access default project resources by exploiting entitlement checks against the requested project. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq directives to execute code as root on the host, or manipulate inherited resources via the ?project= parameter.

items.title: CVE-2026-130783 - Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through th...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through the default project event stream and skips authorization when cancelling operations without associated permissions. Restricted clients can subscribe to operation events to capture certificate tokens and enroll unrestricted certificates, gaining full server access, or cancel token operations by UUID.

items.title: CVE-2026-130782 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted and view-only clients to read default project resources by requesting the default project directly. Attackers knowing resource names can read profiles, images, network zone peer keys and stored credentials, and export custom volume or bucket backups to obtain full contents or S3 admin keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-130781 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the storage b...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the storage bucket S3 listener, which buffers entire signed request bodies in memory before verifying the signature or credential role. Attackers knowing only a valid access key, or holding a read-only credential, can send many concurrent large requests to exhaust daemon memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-130780 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories by supplying unvalidated dependent volume and snapshot names in the migration offer header. Attackers controlling a migration source can create root-owned volumes with attacker content at arbitrary host paths, compromising hosts using dir storage pools, bypassing restricted.storage-pools.access, or crashing the daemon.

items.title: CVE-2026-130779 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users per...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users permitted to import custom volumes to store unvalidated snapshot names from the backup index configuration section. Attackers can craft a backup with traversal sequences in snapshot names so later deletion removes arbitrary host directories as root, while renaming or mounting operates on arbitrary paths.

items.title: CVE-2026-130778 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows r...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.

items.title: CVE-2026-130777 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows project-restricted authenticated clients to receive other projects' OVN ACL logs because these events are broadcast with an empty project. Attackers can subscribe to network-acl events on one accessible project to observe internal IPs, ports, protocols, and allow/drop decisions across all projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130776 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with project event-view access to read migration websocket secrets broadcast in operation metadata. Attackers can connect to in-flight migration control and fs websockets before the legitimate peer, hijacking the transfer to obtain instance configuration and filesystem data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130775 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /dev/in...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest-API image export handler that fails to pin the project parameter to the guest's own project. Container root users with the guest-API image entitlement can supply another project in the project query parameter to export public or cached images, including non-public images pulled from authenticated remotes.

items.title: CVE-2026-130774 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a n...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container makes it boot without a user namespace. Root processes inside the container run as host uid 0, keeping capabilities like sys_module, with no device cgroup restriction, letting them load kernel modules and compromise the host.

items.title: CVE-2026-130773 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted proje...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted project users to create resources in the unrestricted default project by targeting projects lacking features.* flags. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq dhcp-script injection to run scripts as root, or custom volumes with block.create_options mkfs arguments to read host files.

items.title: CVE-2026-130772 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted TLS clients to read other projects' bucket S3 keys and profile configuration through recursive and all-projects responses. Attackers can query bucket listings with recursion=2 or profiles with all-projects=true to obtain S3 secret keys and sensitive environment, cloud-init and user values across projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130771 - Incus before 7.6.0 fails to reject special files, hard links, or symlinks in bac...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 fails to reject special files, hard links, or symlinks in backup or image metadata, allowing restricted project users to read or overwrite host files. Attackers can import crafted backups containing device nodes, a hard-linked backup.yaml, or symlinks to corrupt host storage, overwrite host files, or leak other projects' data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130770 - Incus before 7.6.0 creates the NBD servers used for virtual machine migration an...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 creates the NBD servers used for virtual machine migration and disk export on abstract unix sockets, which have no permission checks and whose names are visible in /proc/net/unix. A local unprivileged user can connect while an operation runs to read or modify the VM disk, gaining code execution in the guest on a migration's receiving side.

items.title: CVE-2026-130769 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows client...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows clients permitted to create instances to crash the daemon by importing a backup with a null snapshot entry in index.yaml. Attackers can trigger an unrecovered nil pointer dereference during configuration rewrite, terminating the daemon and all containers and virtual machines on the node.

items.title: CVE-2026-130768 - Obot from 0.14.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerabil...
items.body: Obot from 0.14.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Power Users to bypass outbound protections by supplying unspecified addresses, IPv6 transition addresses, or registry icon URLs. Attackers can add remote MCP servers pointing to 0.0.0.0, ::, or NAT64/6to4/Teredo addresses embedding blocked IPv4 addresses to probe internal services for reachability.

items.title: CVE-2026-130767 - Obot from 0.9.0 before 0.27.0 contains a command injection vulnerability that al...
items.body: Obot from 0.9.0 before 0.27.0 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute shell commands by embedding an EOF line in file-type MCP server configuration values. Attackers can terminate the heredoc in the generated init container script to run commands, modify the MCP server files volume, and reach services on Obot's Docker network.

items.title: CVE-2026-130766 - Obot from 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 fails to validate the resource identifier in remo...
items.body: Obot from 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 fails to validate the resource identifier in remote MCP server protected resource metadata, allowing malicious MCP servers to steal access tokens. Attackers can name a different service and authorization server with chosen scopes, causing Obot to obtain the victim's token for that service and forward it to the attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-130765 - Obot before 0.27.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthent...
items.body: Obot before 0.27.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass same-site validation of the rd parameter by inserting a tab character. Attackers can craft sign-in or sign-out links on the Obot domain that browsers resolve to external hosts, redirecting victims to phishing pages.

items.title: CVE-2026-130764 - Obot from 0.8.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerabili...
items.body: Obot from 0.8.0 before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Power User accounts to reach internal hosts by advertising a malicious OAuth token endpoint in remote MCP server metadata. Attackers can direct token exchange or refresh requests, including redirected GET requests, to cloud metadata services or private-network hosts and read error response bodies.

items.title: CVE-2026-130763 - Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability in the host i...
items.body: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability in the host inventory export endpoint that allows attackers controlling an enrolled host or enroll secret to plant spreadsheet formulas. Attackers can set osquery-reported fields like hostname or hardware serial to formula values, enabling data exfiltration or DDE command execution when users open the exported CSV.

items.title: CVE-2026-130762 - Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenti...
items.body: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated observer-level users to sort software listings by arbitrary columns via the order_key parameter. Attackers can order by joined hosts table columns such as node keys and use pagination as a binary-search oracle to extract sensitive column values.

items.title: CVE-2026-130761 - Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows enrol...
items.body: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows enrolled hosts to trigger unbounded per-name database lookups by submitting osquery result logs. Attackers with a valid host node key can send one request to /api/osquery/log containing many distinct query names, exhausting database connections and read replica capacity.

items.title: CVE-2026-130760 - Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unaut...

Attackers can send deeply nested indefinite-length structures to Apple MDM check-in, enrollment, SCEP, or OTA endpoints to crash the entire Fleet instance.

items.title: CVE-2026-130759 - Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability ...
items.body: Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SAML SSO callback that looks up sessions using unvalidated client-supplied identifiers. Users able to run live queries or enroll secret holders can plant attacker-controlled identity provider metadata in the session store, then present a self-signed SAML response to log in as a global admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-130758 - Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the deprec...
items.body: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the deprecated POST /api/latest/fleet/mdm/apple/enqueue endpoint that allows team-scoped users to enqueue Apple MDM commands outside their teams. Attackers with team admin, maintainer, or GitOps roles can include one own-team host UUID alongside unresolved enrollment IDs to send commands like InstallProfile to deleted or user-channel enrollments without activity logging.

items.title: CVE-2026-130757 - Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allow...
items.body: Fleet before 4.92.0 contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse case-mutated security tokens because MySQL token columns used case-insensitive collation. items.title: CVE-2026-130755 - Froxlor before 2.3.16 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows...

Unauthenticated attackers using an OAuth/OIDC provider that asserts a victim's email can log in as any user, including Superadmin, and keep persistent access through a linked social_accounts entry.

An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this by crafting a URL containing HTML metacharacters to break out of the href attribute and execute arbitrary HTML or JavaScript in the context of the victim's browser.

The application renders the stored post content without proper output encoding in news-details.php, allowing injected JavaScript to execute in the browsers of users who visit the affected article.

MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform) contains an authorization bypass in the SharingGroup model's captureSGExisting method. The authorization check used a logical AND condition that effectively exempted users with the sync permission (perm_sync) from the membership verification. Specifically, the original condition 'if (!checkIfAuthorised(...) && !perm_sync) return false' meant that any user holding the sync role would pass the check regardless of whether they were actually a member of the target sharing group.

A sync user who knows or can discover the UUID of a non-local sharing group could exploit this flaw through the /sharing_groups/add endpoint or by embedding a SharingGroup object in pushed sync data. The attacker could rewrite the sharing group record to add their own organisation as a member or insert an all_orgs server entry for their MISP instance, thereby gaining read access to all events contained in that group. This exposes threat intelligence data that was intended to be restricted to the group's legitimate members.

The vulnerability requires an authenticated account with the sync role and knowledge of a valid sharing group UUID. No user interaction is required. The impact is unauthorized disclosure of shared threat intelligence events and limited integrity modification of the sharing group record.

items.body: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames. `net__read_ws()` in `lib/net_ws.c` returns the number of framing bytes consumed (the 4 masking-key bytes) for a data frame with a zero-length payload, without writing any bytes to the caller’s buffer. The MQTT packet reader in `packet__read_single()` (`lib/packet_mosq.c`) trusts that return value as a payload byte count. A remote client can therefore advance the read position over an uninitialised heap allocation, causing the broker to process and forward uninitialised heap memory (information disclosure, including heap and libc pointers), and can underflow the unsigned `to_process` counter so that subsequent attacker-controlled frame data is written past the end of the allocation (heap out-of-bounds write). The out-of-bounds write is reachable from the CONNECT packet before any authentication check, so an unauthenticated client can corrupt the heap and crash the broker even when `allow_anonymous false` is set. Combining the disclosure and the write allows remote code execution as the broker’s user by any client able to establish a session.

items.title: CVE-2026-58320 - Missing Authorization vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. The system snapsh...
items.body:
Missing Authorization vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) checked only that the caller was logged in, not the read_servers or manage_servers permission. Any authenticated user, including a user with no permissions, could download a diagnostic archive with the server log files, the host process list, a file system listing and the runtime server configuration. The runtime configuration contains the HTTP JWT signing secret and the message encryption key when they are set in the configuration. If HTTP is enabled, the user could use the signing secret to create tokens for any account, including root.

This issue affects Apache Iggy: before 0.9.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.
